_comment: Provenance manifest for every icon shipped in src/icons/.
This file is the authority for three things:
1. tools/fetch-icons.mjs  — what to download and how to normalise it
2. tools/build-credits.mjs — the attribution block in README.md
3. tests/icons.test.mjs   — that presets, manifest and disk agree
Every set here is GPL-3.0-or-later compatible. Do not add a set without
reading its own LICENSE file first — see README 'Icon credits'.
'grid' is the upstream viewBox size. The fetch script scales each icon to
a 24x24 viewBox so all sets share one optical size. A set's grid is not
always uniform — see 'gridOverrides' — so the fetch script refuses to
write an icon whose real viewBox disagrees with what is declared here.

temaki.name: Temaki (rapideditor)
temaki.note: What the iD editor uses for OSM presets — the best semantic match for street furniture. Public domain dedication; attribution is courtesy, not obligation.

maki.name: Maki (Mapbox)
maki.note: Public domain dedication; attribution is courtesy, not obligation. Kartographer and Iconify's 'maki' collection are this set re-hosted — pull from mapbox/maki directly.

mdi.name: Material Design Icons (Pictogrammers)
mdi.note: Apache-2.0 REQUIRES that this attribution notice be retained in distributions. Keep the icon credits section in README.md.

custom.name: Flaneur surveillance set (this repo)
custom.note: Original work, dedicated to the public domain. Drawn for this project because no freely-licensed set anywhere ships a dome, PTZ, ALPR, thermal or acoustic-sensor camera. Authored by hand, NOT fetched — tools/fetch-icons.mjs skips this set. Several of these icons stroke as well as fill, so style them with `color:`, never `fill:` alone.
